 Has Diomande already ousted Vinícius? 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article The Ivorian is starting to earn a place in Real Madrid ’s starting XI. 
 Yan Diomande could not have asked for a better Clásico debut. The Ivorian winger started in Real Madrid’s 2-1 win over Barcelona at Camp Nou and delivered a performance that confirmed his progress in recent weeks. Involved, dangerous and committed defensively too, he was one of the players who caused Hansi Flick’s side the most problems.
 OneFootball Videos
 The 19-year-old produced several moments of quality, including a nutmeg on Lamine Yamal, and played an important role in Kylian Mbappé’s opening goal, reaching the byline and creating the move that ended with the Frenchman scoring. His contribution was not limited to attack: he also helped out defensively and provided support on a flank that demanded plenty of work.
 Diomande had shown promising signs against Sevilla and Leipzig, but the match in Barcelona marks a step forward in his adaptation to life at Madrid. José Mourinho had already praised his performances and now has even more reason to trust him. The winger is beginning to justify the club’s faith in him and is emerging as an important player for what lies ahead.
